method_or_finding: Concept bottleneck independent/sequential/joint training; concept interventions
exact_supported_claim: On OAI knee radiographs and CUB birds, supervised concepts can mediate prediction; replacing predicted concepts with supplied concepts can alter predictions (Sections 2–4).
task_limitation: No coffee evidence; CUB class-level majority concepts are not individual sensory truth; model intervention is not a causal tasting intervention; predictive accuracy alone does not validate concept semantics.
candidate_component: Masked sensory foundation; cross-fitted concept predictions
proposed_experiment: Compare no-foundation against foundation at identical split/budget; mask unavailable concepts; downstream training uses out-of-fold predicted concepts; freeze profile before new evidence.
data_availability: Original full paper PDF acquired and read; paper code/data links are non-coffee and not ingested.

method_or_finding: Single free sorting with hierarchical clustering and multidimensional scaling
exact_supported_claim: 72 sorters (29 sensory professionals, 43 industry participants) sorted 99 written terms without tasting coffee; pooled sorting proximity informed a lexical hierarchy (Methods).
task_limitation: Term similarity is not measured coffee co-occurrence, intensity, or an independent answer; no copying of wheel layout, full vocabulary or definitions.
proposed_experiment: Ablate a lexical prior against train-only empirical co-occurrence; retain heterogeneous evidence grades and compound terms.
data_availability: Original full JATS XML acquired/read via PMC5215420; no sample-level sensory matrix supplied by this sorting task.

method_or_finding: Trained-panel lexicon development and validation; separate sensory modalities
exact_supported_claim: Development examined 105 coffees from 14 countries; validation used 20 coffees and six panelists with three replicates; 0–15 half-point ratings; 35 always-rated attributes plus optional additional attributes (Methods).
task_limitation: Optional unselected attributes do not establish all-110 true zeros; aroma/flavor/taste/mouthfeel/quality are distinct; lexicon references are not per-coffee labels; source access does not authorize vocabulary republication.
proposed_experiment: Audit every target for scale and observation status; compare correctly masked broad attributes against descriptor recovery without equating quality and intensity.
data_availability: Original full PDF acquired/read at university research-literature repository; original paper DOI retained; no new raw panel matrix acquired.
decision: TEST_MEASUREMENT_METHOD; do not import full lexicon

method_or_finding: Acquisition-conditioned oracle estimates expected loss for sets of future acquisitions
exact_supported_claim: Equation 2 conditions only on already observed features; AACO uses training-data nearest-neighbor conditional estimates and subset search; unobserved test features and test labels cannot drive a deployable oracle (Sections 3.2–3.5, 4).
task_limitation: One/two-step constrained coffee planning is an adaptation, not full AACO replication; benchmark gains do not establish coffee-question value; sparse conditional support may fail.
proposed_experiment: Compare greedy and one/two-step planning under identical Q0–Q5 budgets and allowed paths; fit conditional distributions only within training groups; include a static baseline.
data_availability: Original full PMLR PDF acquired/read; author code public; no external benchmark observations ingested.

method_or_finding: Drip-brew response surfaces for strength, extraction yield and roast
exact_supported_claim: Original publisher abstract describes one wet-washed Arabica coffee, three roast levels and nine TDS/PE targets per roast; 21 of 30 attributes differed for at least one factor.
task_limitation: FULL_TEXT_NOT_ACQUIRED; abstract-only evidence does not verify panel details, scale, preparation or row matrix; one coffee cannot justify universal roast effects; no coefficient or label extraction.
proposed_experiment: Use as a bounded motivation to test context interactions with eligible observed data; do not derive training weights or seven-bin roast mappings from the abstract.
data_availability: Publisher abstract and supplement inventory read; full publisher requests inaccessible; OpenAlex indicated closed access; no raw data admitted.

method_or_finding: Factorial descriptive analysis of origin, roast and brew temperature under cold service
exact_supported_claim: Three original coffees × three native roast levels × three brew temperatures produced 27 conditions and 81 preparations; 27 attributes rated 0–100. Concentrates brewed at 4/22/92°C to equilibrium were diluted to 2% TDS, refrigerated overnight and assessed cold (Methods).
task_limitation: Three original coffee groups, not 81 independent coffees; processing and origin differ together; dilution and cold service constrain generalization; Agtron 58/48/38 are study-native roast anchors, not calibrated production C1.
proposed_experiment: Stratify roast/brew/serving conditions; keep coffee grouping; compare context ablations only with acquired eligible rows and never supply unobserved laboratory measurements at runtime.
data_availability: Original full XML acquired/read via PMC9407127; raw data stated available on request and not requested; figure-only supplement not row-level data.

method_or_finding: Time-resolved sensory changes in full-immersion coffee
exact_supported_claim: One Central-American blend at two native roasts, three brew temperatures and five temperature-specific extraction times yields 30 conditions. Fourteen panelists used 0–100 scales. Results and supplementary tables contain 28 attributes, while Methods says 27; diluted samples were refrigerated overnight and served cold.
task_limitation: One blend is one group; temperature-specific times, dilution, storage and serving conditions prevent universal causal C0/C1 conclusions; compound attributes stay whole; source-native roast is not seven-bin C1.
proposed_experiment: Use source-native measured conditions only; hold all trajectories of a coffee together; forbid aggregation from entering unrelated fresh-coffee evaluation.
data_availability: Original full XML already cached and reread; published Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.v15dv423h API reports not viewable/missing required elements; landing 404; acquired supplementary DOCX has standards/ANOVA/plots, no sensory rows; raw matrix not admitted.
decision: TEST_CONTEXT_METHOD; existing aggregates are not new D1 samples

method_or_finding: Controlled drip-brew temperature experiment at fixed strength and extraction
exact_supported_claim: One Honduras coffee, 27 combinations of three temperatures (87/90/93°C), TDS and extraction yields; 12 trained panelists, triplicate evaluations, 31 sensory attributes on a 0–100 line scale; temperature effects were small under matched TDS/extraction (Methods/Results).
task_limitation: Conditional result is not temperature irrelevance for immersion or arbitrary brew strength; one coffee and related Cotter source may share coffee identity; group-level means cannot reconstruct panel answers.
proposed_experiment: Compare context models with equal measured-support masks; keep matching coffee families together; use sensory means only in explicitly separate aggregate supervision.
data_availability: Original full XML acquired/read via PMC7536440; public supplementary archive acquired separately; no new independent coffee count from this paper.
decision: ADDITIONAL_FULL_TEXT_METHOD; seven full original papers read including this row
